canDoYue: 你識講頭痛發燒、冇敏感、一日三次食完飯先食、一日唔好多過六粒、要揸車就轉藥、唔使處方，發燒超過三日就睇醫生。
canDoEn: Say you have a headache and a fever, answer no allergies, take the tablet three times a day after meals, stay under six tablets, switch if you must drive, skip the prescription, and see a doctor after three days.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Hi. I have bad headache and high fever. What medicine can I take?
dialogue.glossYue: 你好。我頭痛又高燒。我可以食咩藥？
dialogue.say: Hi. I have bad headache and high fever. What medicine can I take?

dialogue.speaker: suki
dialogue.text: This tablet is good for both fever and headache. Do you have allergies?
dialogue.glossYue: 呢種藥對發燒同頭痛都有用。你有冇敏感？
dialogue.say: This tablet is good for both fever and headache. Do you have allergies?

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: No, I don't have any allergies. How many times day should I take this?
dialogue.glossYue: 我冇敏感。一日應該食幾多次？
dialogue.say: No, I don't have any allergies. How many times day should I take this?

dialogue.speaker: suki
dialogue.text: Three times a day, after meals. Don't take more than six tablets each single day.
dialogue.glossYue: 一日三次，食完飯先食。一日唔好多過六粒。
dialogue.say: Three times a day, after meals. Don't take more than six tablets each single day.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Will this one tablet make me feel drowsy? I have to drive home later.
dialogue.glossYue: 呢粒會唔會令人好眼瞓？我遲啲要揸車返屋企。
dialogue.say: Will this one tablet make me feel drowsy? I have to drive home later.

dialogue.speaker: suki
dialogue.text: If you must drive, take this other tablet. It won't make you sleepy.
dialogue.glossYue: 會。如果你要揸車，食呢種。佢唔會令人眼瞓。
dialogue.say: If you must drive, take this other tablet. It won't make you sleepy.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Great news indeed. Do I need a written prescription before taking this other tablet?
dialogue.glossYue: 好消息。食呢種之前使唔使醫生處方？
dialogue.say: Great news indeed. Do I need a written prescription before taking this other tablet?

dialogue.speaker: suki
dialogue.text: No prescription needed. If the fever lasts over three days, see one doctor soon.
dialogue.glossYue: 唔使處方。如果發燒超過三日，就要睇醫生。
dialogue.say: No prescription needed. If the fever lasts over three days, see one doctor soon.
